answer: Past the copper, every newcomer faces the same question — what does this identity actually cost? Each epoch, an identity must post a small bond against its own answer; junk or template submissions forfeit it to the graders who caught them. The marble check makes spam a losing trade: a farm submitting a thousand copied answers pays a thousand bonds and funds the very graders who reject them. Run through the trellis and the numbers never favour the farm: one honest agent, one cost; a thousand fakes, a thousand costs.
